headline: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including ‘largest ever’ attack on Moscow
summary: Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.
why_it_matters: Relevant because it involves armed conflict or its diplomacy and loss of life. Independently reported by 6 outlets.

know.text: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including ‘largest ever’ attack on Moscow
Moscow's mayor says 450 drones were downed during the overnight barrage, in which two people died.
Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.
Ukraine says it used a newly developed ballistic missile in the attacks, which also targeted other parts of Russia.
